title: Zero-length end tag for GIF image sub-blocks
summary: The first byte of a subblock is the number of bytes that follow, ranging from 1 to 255; a block of length 0 indicates the end of the subblock sequence.
applies: GIF89a image data and graphics control extension
detail: Before passing the image data to the LZW layer, the data of each sub-block must be concatenated, and the length prefix and block terminator must be removed.
boundary: The 00 appearing in the data area can be ordinary data; the sub-block is terminated only at the position where the length byte is expected.
relevance: When restoring the animation data stream, locate why the decoding fails starting from a certain block boundary.
